candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (Supplement to the Official Journal of the EU) / SK: Dodatok k Úradnému vestníku EÚ
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated EU-wide publication channel for all above-threshold Slovak public contracts, including banking, payment, card-acquiring, cash-handling and core-banking IT procurements by Slovak public bodies, state banks (Eximbanka, SZRB), ministries and municipalities. Parallel to the national ÚVO Vestník but with structured eForms data, multilingual metadata and machine access.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the TED Search API (/v3/notices/search) with expert queries filtering country=SVK and CPV 66xxxxxx / 72xxxxxx families; fall back to HTML notice pages only for spot checks.
queries_used: TED europa eu tender Slovakia banking services contract award notice CPV 66110000
verejné obstarávanie Slovensko oznámenie Úradný vestník EÚ TED bankové služby platobné systémy

candidates.source_name: TED Search API v3 (docs.ted.europa.eu)
candidates.why_relevant: Documented, authentication-free read API over all TED notices; the primary machine-collection route for Slovak banking/payment tenders and award notices. Supports expert query language over eForms fields (buyer country, CPV, value, winner name).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled API polling (daily) against /v3/notices/search; persist raw JSON/XML per notice id.
queries_used: TED API v3 developer documentation search notices eForms JSON bulk download

candidates.source_name: TED bulk XML download (daily/monthly notice packages)
candidates.why_relevant: Full-archive bulk packages of TED notices in XML from 2011 onward (older archives via FTP), enabling historical baselining of Slovak banking/payment procurement volumes, incumbents and price levels rather than only forward-looking monitoring.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download monthly packages via direct URL pattern (https://ted.europa.eu/packages/notice/daily/{yyyynnnnn}), filter offline to SK buyers.
queries_used: data.europa.eu dataset TED public procurement notices bulk XML monthly packages ted-data

candidates.source_name: TED Open Data Service (data.ted.europa.eu)
candidates.why_relevant: Publications Office open-data front end for TED notices; complements the Search API for reuse-oriented datasets and SPARQL/linked-data style access to procurement notices including Slovak ones.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Dataset/endpoint discovery once, then scheduled dataset pulls; cross-check IDs against TED Search API.
queries_used: data.europa.eu dataset TED public procurement notices bulk XML monthly packages ted-data

candidates.source_name: data.europa.eu — TED procurement notices dataset (Slovak locale view)
candidates.why_relevant: EU official open-data catalogue entry for TED notices, exposed in Slovak; useful as a stable catalogue pointer to distributions (CSV subset, XML) and licence terms for reuse.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read dataset metadata to resolve current distribution URLs; do not treat as primary feed.
queries_used: "ted.europa.eu" notice Slovakia "66172000" OR "72212442" bankový systém obstarávanie oznámenie

candidates.source_name: TED eForms standard and eForms SDK
candidates.why_relevant: Defines the field/schema vocabulary (business terms, codelists, CPV usage) that Slovak notices are published in since Nov 2022. Essential to build reliable parsers and to know which fields (winner ID, framework agreement, estimated value) are actually machine-readable.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off ingestion of SDK codelists from the OP-TED GitHub repo; re-check on SDK version bumps.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from TED API docs and Slovak SIMAP pages
queries_used: eNotices2 TED eSender Slovensko ÚVO odosielanie oznámení do Úradného vestníka EÚ eForms SK

candidates.source_name: TED eSenders list (SK: zoznam elektronických odosielateľov)
candidates.why_relevant: Identifies which Slovak systems/organisations transmit notices to TED (ÚVO eForms IS and any commercial eSenders). Reveals the upstream national systems whose data can be tapped directly and explains publication lags/duplication between ÚVO Vestník and TED.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic (quarterly) scrape of the eSender list; use as actor-map input.
queries_used: eNotices2 TED eSender Slovensko ÚVO odosielanie oznámení do Úradného vestníka EÚ eForms SK

candidates.source_name: TED release calendar (kalendár zverejnenia Úradného vestníka série S)
candidates.why_relevant: Publication schedule of the OJ S series; needed to time collection jobs and to interpret gaps in Slovak notice flow as calendar effects rather than market signals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download once per year; drives scheduler configuration.
queries_used: eNotices2 TED eSender Slovensko ÚVO odosielanie oznámení do Úradného vestníka EÚ eForms SK

candidates.source_name: SIMAP — European public procurement information (SK version)
candidates.why_relevant: Explains thresholds, CPV nomenclature and the legal basis that determines which Slovak banking/payment contracts must appear at EU level — the rulebook for interpreting coverage and for setting CPV filters.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read; re-check when EU thresholds are revised (biennially).
queries_used: verejné obstarávanie Slovensko oznámenie Úradný vestník EÚ TED bankové služby platobné systémy

candidates.source_name: EUR-Lex — Official Journal direct access (Úradný vestník EÚ, SK)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative archive of the Official Journal in Slovak; useful for legal-status confirmation of procurement rules and for OJ items (state aid, banking-sector decisions) that contextualise Slovak banking procurement but sit outside the S-series.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted queries via EUR-Lex search/webservice; not a bulk feed for this cell.
queries_used: eNotices2 TED eSender Slovensko ÚVO odosielanie oznámení do Úradného vestníka EÚ eForms SK

candidates.source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (SEDIA) — procurement/opportunities
candidates.why_relevant: Single entry point for centrally managed EU tenders and grants. Captures EU-institution contracts and programme calls (Digital Europe, Horizon, TSI) where Slovak banks, fintechs or the NBS ecosystem appear as bidders/beneficiaries — spend that never reaches ÚVO.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the portal's public search API endpoints for calls-for-tenders and results, filter participants by SK country code; login only needed for submission, not for reading.
queries_used: EU Funding and Tenders Portal calls for tenders API SEDIA opportunities procurement

candidates.source_name: EU F&T Portal eProcurement wiki (technical/API documentation)
candidates.why_relevant: Documents the portal's data model and access routes, which is how a collector can move from manual browsing to scheduled retrieval of EU-institution tender records relevant to Slovak financial-sector suppliers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read to design the F&T collector; recheck on portal releases.
queries_used: EU Funding and Tenders Portal calls for tenders API SEDIA opportunities procurement

candidates.source_name: EBRD Client e-Procurement Portal (ECEPP) — procurement notices
candidates.why_relevant: Since the EBRD consolidated publication, ECEPP is the only channel for procurement, prequalification and award notices under EBRD-financed projects. Slovak clients (e.g. SEPS-type public-sector borrowers, financial-institution TC assignments) publish here, and these contracts never appear in the ÚVO bulletin.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the public notice listing filtered by country=Slovak Republic; capture displayNoticeId deep links. Registration is only needed to bid, not to read notices — verify robots/ToS before automated crawling.
queries_used: EBRD procurement notice Slovakia payment systems

candidates.source_name: EBRD procurement notices (ebrd.com landing/filtered listing)
candidates.why_relevant: Institutional entry point explaining notice types and routing to ECEPP; also carries the guidance note defining what must be published, which sets expectations for coverage of Slovak operations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read of the guidance note; use ECEPP for the actual feed.
queries_used: EBRD procurement notice Slovakia payment systems

candidates.source_name: EBRD corporate procurement & consultancy services
candidates.why_relevant: EBRD's own-account purchasing of banking/payment-related advisory and IT services; occasionally scopes assignments covering Slovakia or CEE financial-infrastructure diagnostics, signalling upcoming projects before any national tender exists.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency (monthly) listing check with keyword filter for payments/banking/Slovakia.
queries_used: EBRD procurement notice Slovakia payment systems

candidates.source_name: EIB project pages for Slovakia (eib.org/projects)
candidates.why_relevant: EIB project records name Slovak financial-sector intermediaries and beneficiaries (e.g. Eximbanka SR SME/mid-cap lines, EU 2021-2027 co-financing) and state procurement arrangements. These identify institutions likely to run banking/IT procurements and indicate the funding envelope behind them.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the project search filtered country=Slovakia, sector=credit lines/financial services; store project id, promoter, status, procurement section.
queries_used: EIB projects Slovakia bank financing procurement notice

candidates.source_name: EIB press releases — Slovakia country stream
candidates.why_relevant: Earliest public signal of new EIB Group operations in Slovakia, including intermediated lending through Slovak banks — a leading indicator of downstream procurement and of which banks are scaling programmes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/listing poll of eib.org press filtered by country tag Slovakia; entity-extract bank names.
queries_used: EIB projects Slovakia bank financing procurement notice

candidates.source_name: Ministry of Finance SR — International financial institutions / EIB page (MF SR)
candidates.why_relevant: Slovak-state view of its IFI relationships (EIB, EBRD, CEB, World Bank Group), naming the domestic counterparties and programmes through which IFI-financed procurement is channelled — the bridge between the EU/IFI layer and Slovak actors.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off/quarterly read for actor-map maintenance (SK and EN versions).
queries_used: EIB projects Slovakia bank financing procurement notice

candidates.source_name: World Bank Group procurement notices (Finances One / Data Catalog)
candidates.why_relevant: Structured dataset of WBG-financed procurement notices. Slovakia is not a borrowing country, so volume is expected to be near-zero, but WBG Reimbursable Advisory Services in Slovakia can generate consultancy procurement touching public financial management/payments.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency dataset pull with country filter = Slovak Republic; treat empty results as expected.
queries_used: World Bank procurement notices Slovakia

candidates.source_name: Opentender.eu — Slovakia country portal (DIGIWHIST)
candidates.why_relevant: Research-grade re-publication of TED plus the Slovak national procurement archive, with harmonised variables and corruption/competition-risk indicators. Useful as a cross-check on TED coverage and for supplier-level aggregation of Slovak banking/IT contracts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bulk dataset download if offered; otherwise use only for validation, never as the authoritative record (freshness and completeness are not guaranteed).
queries_used: opentender.eu Slovakia TED data portal digiwhist

candidates.source_name: Publications Office public-procurement procurement-details pages (op.europa.eu)
candidates.why_relevant: Publications Office front end presenting individual procurement records (including banking-services CPV 66110000 examples) with a stable UUID-based URL scheme; a secondary rendering of TED content useful for human verification and reusers' workshop material.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/spot use only; prefer TED API for systematic collection.
queries_used: TED europa eu tender Slovakia banking services contract award notice CPV 66110000

candidates.source_name: OP-TED eForms-SDK GitHub repository
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable codelists, schemas and issue tracker for the eForms standard — the practical reference when building a TED collector and when diagnosing why some Slovak fields are missing or coded unexpectedly.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Clone/pin a release tag; watch releases for schema changes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from TED API docs search
queries_used: TED API v3 developer documentation search notices eForms JSON bulk download

candidates.source_name: ÚVO Vestník verejného obstarávania (national bulletin — cross-layer anchor)
candidates.why_relevant: Belongs to the national layer but is the required cross-reference for this cell: it carries below-threshold Slovak banking/payment contracts that never reach TED, and since Aug 2024 must publish results for all below-threshold contracts. Needed to measure TED's coverage shortfall for SK.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Owned by the national cell; here use only for TED-vs-national reconciliation on notice IDs.
queries_used: verejné obstarávanie Slovensko oznámenie Úradný vestník EÚ TED bankové služby platobné systémy

candidates.source_name: verejnesutaze.sk — commercial Slovak tender aggregator (TED + national)
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that indexes both national and EU-published Slovak tenders and surfaced a concrete banking case ('Core Banking Systém'), showing that such procurements exist and are discoverable by Slovak keyword. Useful for keyword discovery and alerting, not as an authoritative record.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual keyword reconnaissance only; do not scrape systematically without checking ToS. Resolve any hit back to the TED/ÚVO original.
queries_used: verejné obstarávanie Slovensko oznámenie Úradný vestník EÚ TED bankové služby platobné systémy

negative_findings.description: Neither the English nor the Slovak query surfaced a concrete, citable TED notice for a Slovak banking-services contract under CPV 66110000/66172000 via general web search; the only banking-services CPV example returned was Slovenian, not Slovak.
negative_findings.result_summary: General web search engines index TED notice PDFs only sparsely; CPV+country retrieval must be done inside TED's own search/API, not via external search engines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the collection design must be API-first. It also means the volume of SK banking-sector notices cannot be estimated from this scouting pass and remains an open empirical question.

negative_findings.description: No EBRD or EIB procurement notice was found that names a Slovak bank or payment-infrastructure operator as beneficiary. EBRD Slovak examples found were energy/transport (SEPS substations, electric buses); EIB Slovak operations found were energy, urban and SME credit lines (Eximbanka).
negative_findings.result_summary: IFI activity in Slovakia is real but concentrated outside banking/payment infrastructure; the closest financial-sector link is intermediated lending via Eximbanka SR and EU co-financing lines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Tempers the cell rationale: IFI procurement is a thin channel for SK banking/payments. It should be monitored at low frequency, with the financial-intermediary angle (which banks on-lend IFI money) treated as the more valuable signal than IFI procurement notices themselves.

negative_findings.description: Council of Europe Development Bank (CEB), EIF and NIB procurement/beneficiary channels for Slovakia were not searched in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only EIB, EBRD and World Bank were covered among IFIs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: CEB and EIF have Slovak exposure via social infrastructure and guarantee instruments intermediated by Slovak banks, so a residual IFI blind spot remains.

negative_findings.description: No page in this pass was fetched directly; all findings come from search-engine result summaries. ECEPP and the F&T Portal in particular are known to be JavaScript-heavy and may be bot-defended.
negative_findings.result_summary: All URLs are recorded as candidates with confidence scores, not as verified-live endpoints.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A downstream deterministic liveness/robots pass is required before any of these are wired into a collector; a 403 from ECEPP should be read as bot defence, not as a dead source.

negative_findings.description: The EU/IFI layer is almost entirely English-only: EBRD, EIB, World Bank and the F&T Portal publish notices in English, and TED's Slovak interface exists but notice bodies for SK buyers are in Slovak with limited machine translation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovak-language search was productive only for TED/SIMAP/ÚVO-facing pages; no Slovak-language IFI procurement source exists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword strategies must be bilingual and asymmetric: Slovak terms for TED notice bodies, English terms for IFI portals.

coverage_gaps.description: The actual number and character of Slovak banking/payment notices on TED is unknown — no counts by CPV, year, buyer type or winner were established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a TED Search API expert query for country SVK across CPV 66xxxxxx (financial/banking/insurance), 30162000/30123000 (POS/card terminals) and 72xxxxxx banking-IT codes for the last 5 years, and record counts before designing the ongoing feed.

coverage_gaps.description: No agreed CPV code list for 'banking and payments' has been fixed for this run; scouting used ad-hoc codes (66110000, 66172000, 72212442).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define and version a canonical CPV allow-list (banking, payment processing, cash handling and transport, card personalisation, POS/ATM hardware, core-banking software, AML/KYC services) and store it alongside the collector config.

coverage_gaps.description: Notices published under the utilities/defence directives and under concessions use different eForms notice subtypes; these were not examined and may carry payment/cash-handling contracts of Slovak state entities.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate eForms notice subtypes in the SDK and confirm the collector's query does not silently exclude utilities, concessions or design contests.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell covers Slovak buyers, but Slovak/CEE payment vendors also win contracts published by buyers in other member states; those notices would be missed by a buyer-country=SVK filter.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a second TED query dimension filtering on winner/economic-operator country = SK, and on named vendor strings, independent of buyer country.

coverage_gaps.description: TED only carries above-threshold contracts; a large share of Slovak banking/payment procurement (especially municipal and small-agency card/POS/cash services) will sit below EU thresholds.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Explicitly pair the TED feed with the ÚVO Vestník feed owned by the national cell, and quantify the split once both feeds run.

coverage_gaps.description: Reuse conditions were not confirmed for ECEPP, the F&T Portal and opentender.eu; only TED/data.europa.eu are clearly open-reuse.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check robots.txt and terms of use for each non-TED source and record an explicit collection_allowed verdict before automating.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-funded Slovak projects (Recovery and Resilience Plan, Partnership Agreement 2021-2027) generate procurement announced through national EU-funds portals rather than TED when below threshold; these were not scouted here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign a follow-up cell to Slovak EU-funds portals (e.g. partnerskadohoda.gov.sk, planobnovy.sk) as the funding-side counterpart to this EU publication layer.

brief: The EU publication layer for Slovak banking and payments procurement is anchored on TED, which since November 2022 publishes Slovak above-threshold notices in the eForms standard and exposes them through an unauthenticated Search API, bulk XML packages and the TED Open Data Service — making it the best-structured and most machine-tractable channel in this run, and clearly superior to the national bulletin for automated collection. Slovak notices reach TED via the ÚVO eForms information system acting as eSender, so TED and the ÚVO Vestník are two renderings of the same underlying filings, with TED carrying only the above-threshold subset and the national bulletin carrying the below-threshold remainder. The EU Funding & Tenders Portal adds a distinct, smaller stream of EU-institution contracts and programme calls where Slovak financial-sector actors appear as bidders or beneficiaries. The IFI channel is thinner than the cell rationale assumed: EBRD notices for Slovakia now flow exclusively through ECEPP and the Slovak examples found are energy and transport, while EIB's Slovak book is energy, urban and SME credit lines intermediated by Eximbanka — so IFI sources are worth low-frequency monitoring mainly as leading indicators of which institutions are scaling programmes, not as a procurement feed.
